reason: Jujía quedó detrás de José Juan, invirtiendo quién muestra el regreso.

shot.title: Jujía muestra el regreso
shot.visual: Wide inside-to-outside view of dark cut-paper underground passage. EXACTLY TWO small adult people walking toward the bright opening at upper right. Jujia the gray-haired woman in CHARCOAL/BROWN manta is AHEAD, at x62%,y46%, closest to the exit, her whole figure only15% image height. Jose the man in IVORY SHIRT and SAND TROUSERS FOLLOWS BEHIND at x38%,y65%, farther from the exit. Both face upper right; show side profiles, no sculpted heads. Their order is essential: older dark-clothed woman shows the way, young ivory-clothed man follows, never reversed. A BROAD connected ochre ground layer lifts in one gentle internal paper fold immediately AHEAD OF JUJIA and continues into the daylight gap. Both feet supported, no floating bridge, stairs, rays or spells. Huge asymmetric slate-paper walls with visible thin cut edges and air gaps, no real rock textures, sparse paper shrubs near opening only. No ropes or extra people.
shot.transition_to_next: Corte al siguiente episodio, permitiendo salto temporal explícito de la VO.

magic_in_the_ordinary.impossible_behavior: One connected earth sheet unfolds all the way toward an exit.
magic_in_the_ordinary.narrative_effect: A former adversary makes return possible.
magic_in_the_ordinary.agency: Agencia correspondiente al relato; no poderes ni símbolos tradicionales nuevos. La forma de papel es traducción editorial.
magic_in_the_ordinary.physical_translation: dark foreground ground sheet; two walking silhouettes; connected unrolled ochre path; low warm daylight gap
magic_in_the_ordinary.visible_test: The same broad ochre layer joins the leading foot to the opening without floating or breaking.
